Theorem
[Uniqueness of the Universal Covering Group]

↗ prob:7-5

1. ch7:7.9For a connected Lie group $G$, if simply connected Lie groups $\widetilde G$ and $\widetilde G'$ admit smooth covering homomorphisms $\pi :\widetilde G\to G$ and $\pi ':\widetilde G'\to G$, then there is a Lie group isomorphism $\Phi :\widetilde G\to \widetilde G'$ satisfying $\pi '\circ \Phi =\pi $.
